backtranslations.spanish: {rule} {fact} Seleccionando entre SÍ si se deduce, NO si se deduce su negación, o DESCONOCIDO si no se puede determinar ninguna de las dos, identifique si {target} es una implicación directa.
backtranslations.back: {rule} {fact} Selecting from YES if it is deduced, NO if its negation is deduced, or UNKNOWN if neither can be determined, identify if {target} is a direct implication.

backtranslations.original: Determine the entailment status of {target} relative to {rule} and {fact}, responding with strictly YES if it follows, NO if its negation follows, or UNKNOWN if neither can be determined.
backtranslations.spanish: Determine el estado de implicación de {target} con respecto a {rule} y {fact}, respondiendo estrictamente con SÍ si se deduce, NO si se deduce su negación, o DESCONOCIDO si no se puede determinar ninguna de las dos.
backtranslations.back: Determine the entailment status of {target} with respect to {rule} and {fact}, responding strictly with YES if it is inferred, NO if its negation is inferred, or UNKNOWN if neither can be determined.

backtranslations.original: Think carefully and then respond with YES if it follows, NO if its negation follows, or UNKNOWN if neither can be determined, using only one word, regarding {rule} {fact} {target}
backtranslations.spanish: Piensa detenidamente y luego responde con SÍ si se deduce, NO si se deduce su negación, o DESCONOCIDO si no se puede determinar ninguna de las dos, usando solo una palabra, con respecto a {rule} {fact} {target}.
backtranslations.back: Think carefully and then respond with YES if it follows, NO if its negation follows, or UNKNOWN if neither can be determined, using only one word, with respect to {rule} {fact} {target}.

backtranslations.original: Analyze whether {target} is a necessary result of {rule} and {fact} if you wouldn't mind, then provide YES if it follows, NO if its negation follows, or UNKNOWN if neither is certain, as a single word.
backtranslations.spanish: Analiza si {target} es un resultado necesario de {rule} y {fact} si no te importa, y luego indica SÍ si se deduce, NO si se deduce su negación, o DESCONOCIDO si nada es seguro, en una sola palabra.
backtranslations.back: Analyze if {target} is a necessary result of {rule} and {fact} if you don't mind, and then indicate YES if it follows, NO if its negation follows, or UNKNOWN if nothing is certain, in a single word.
